personas.job: Synthesize grounded findings, preserve disagreements, and decide revision order without inventing evidence.
Audit technical soundness, reproducibility, assumptions, statistics, experiments, and limitations.
Audit the contribution boundary, significance, differentiation, and evidence-to-claim strength.
Audit argument flow, reader effort, figure/table use, captions, and venue-facing clarity.
Run auditable live retrieval around the problem, method, and recent temporal neighborhood.
Reconstruct the research trajectory and distinguish durable lineage from recent fashion.
Adversarially search for missing recent baselines, datasets, and evaluation protocols.
Verify suspicious first/best/general/causal claims and record positive or degraded search evidence.
Connect manuscript, literature, and factual lanes while preserving each lane's evidence boundary.
Adjudicate material reviewer conflicts from their receipts; never replace human acceptance authority.
